sections.overall: By a clear margin, the best match of the week was Darby Allin vs Tommaso Ciampa (9.13). What a fantastic way for Darby to begin his first World Title run! Being a main event, on a highly rated Dynamite, with a highly-rated title on the line, this was a big points gain for both.
sections.mens: Kyle Fletcher still holds onto the top spot but in reality, he will drop out next week, as we know of his unfortunate injury. As well as Darby (now at #4) and Tommaso making big gains, keep an eye on Will Ospreay (now at #8). He is steadily gaining places each week and it is surely only a matter of time until he cracks the top 5. With almost all singles matches exclusively on Dynamite and teams on Collision this week, the latter have seen little changes, due to the Collision matches and show having fewer votes and therefore less exposure than the Wednesday flagship programme.
sections.womens: Very little changes in the Women's rankings, after just one single and one tag match this week. Welcome back to Persephone who re-enters at #9. We know she has an AEW contract, so will we see more regular appearances or was this a one-off?
sections.menstag: A few teams featured within the Trios and 10 Man Tag this week. None of which impacted the rankings much, though it is great to see The Hurt Syndicate return! Will they feature in straight tag matches, or continue to partner up with Chris Jericho in Trios?
sections.womenstag: The one Women's Tag match included two first-time teams (Blue/Thekla and Persephone/Windsor). As two matches are required to enter the rankings, time will tell if either duo will do so.
sections.trios: The Demand continue their stranglehold on the Trios division, especially with several short-lived teams dropping out this week, meaning only five teams populate the rankings. The Trios champions (Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong) are yet to progress up the rankings after their Collision title defense (rated 6.23). After the belt hopping around a few times in recent weeks, it will be interesting to see if this team starts a decent run of matches.
